summary: Ring Energy, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 44,444,445 shares of common stock at $1.35 per share (a ~18% discount to the $1.65 last sale), expecting $56.4M in net proceeds. The underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 6,666,666 shares. Joint book-running managers are Mizuho, BofA Securities, and Raymond James. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
